data.narrative:
Majestic Labs is a Series A semiconductor company founded by Ofer Shacham, Sha Rabii, and Masumi Reynders, having raised $100M+. Valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 3 public semiconductors (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private peers including SambaNova Systems, Rebellions, d-Matrix, Cerebras, and Credo Semiconductor.

Two triangulation methods apply. Stage-progression uses the $100M total raised as a base proxy, applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement, yielding $200M. Peer-median anchors to 3 same-sector, same-stage companies: SambaNova Systems at $11.0B, Rebellions at $2.3B, and d-Matrix at $2.0B. The median across these three is $2.3B, with a range of $2.0B to $11.0B. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (sector median 18.4x across the three public tickers) cannot be applied due to absence of target revenue data, typical for private companies.

The triangulated valuation range is $170M (low) to $2.7B (high), with a median of $1.3B across the two applicable methods. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around whether Majestic Labs tracks closer to earlier-stage capital efficiency ($200M) or near-term peer valuations ($2.3B median). Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory, technical differentiation versus the peer cohort, and whether the $11.0B SambaNova outlier signals sector exuberance or reflects genuine performance distinctions.
